project_name: EXHILARATION - Techno & Trance Event Artist Tracker Landing Page

art_direction.vibe: Industrial, High-Octane, Cinematic Warehouse Rave, Raw & Kinetic

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold uppercase tracking-tighter leading-none
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold uppercase tracking-tight
typography.label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-lime-400

layout_and_spacing.hero: min-h-screen relative flex flex-col justify-between pt-24 pb-12 px-6 lg:px-12 bg-black text-white overflow-hidden

motion_and_interactions.hero_reveal: Framed masked line-by-line staggered text reveal using Framer Motion
motion_and_interactions.ticker_marquee: Slow editorial continuous scrolling ribbon for upcoming DJ acts & Liverpool venues
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Scale button effects, inner neon glow borders on hover, dynamic cursor tracking on interactive elements
motion_and_interactions.parallax_element: Subtle parallax depth on venue & crowd background layers during scroll

component_structure.Header: Fixed header with backdrop-blur, brand logo EXHILARATION, status dot (LIVE IN LIVERPOOL), nav links, and CTA 'LAUNCH APP' pointing to https://event-artist-tracker.preview.emergentagent.com/
component_structure.HeroSection: Kinetic headline with masked staggered reveal, neon badge, live soundwave canvas, primary & secondary CTAs
component_structure.LiveMarquee: Infinitely sliding editorial ribbon displaying live upcoming Liverpool techno acts & warehouse dates
component_structure.ManifestoChapters: Numbered chapters (01. Track the Underground, 02. Venue Intelligence, 03. Direct Ticket Access) in high contrast bento grids
component_structure.AppShowcase: Interactive live mockup of the tracker app with filter toggles (Hard Techno, Acid, Trance, Industrial) and event card previews
component_structure.WaitlistCapture: Cyberpunk styled newsletter/notify form with interactive feedback via Sonner toast
component_structure.FAQAccordion: Shadcn accordion styled with dark industrial borders and neon hover states
component_structure.Footer: Massive text EXHILARATION watermark, copyright, Liverpool UK location badge, and primary action link

instructions_to_main_agent: File extensions must be .js / .jsx (React JS project, not TypeScript).
Ensure all buttons, inputs, navigation items, and key statistics have unique `data-testid` attributes.
Main CTA buttons must link directly to the app URL: https://event-artist-tracker.preview.emergentagent.com/ with target='_blank' rel='noopener noreferrer'.
Include Google Fonts import for 'Syne' and 'Space Mono' in index.html or index.css.
Use framer-motion for masked text reveals and scroll triggered animations.
Use Sonner for toast feedback on waitlist form submission.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts and standard Vercel dark mode templates.
Never use generic AI emojis (🤖🧠💡) as section icons; use Lucide react icons or clean geometric symbols.
Ensure text contrast meets APCA / WCAG standards against dark backgrounds.
Set data-testid on every interactive element.
